name: Stat Count-Up
use: Numbers typed in Text blocks (25+, 1,200, 98%, $4.5M, 3.2x) count up from 0 as they scroll into view, with a thin accent line growing under each, then end on the exact typed text.
notes: Over the 8 KB budget (unminified) because of the number parser (prefix/suffix/commas/decimals, year and 24/7 skipping), the byte-identical text-node restore and per-marker overrides. The typed number stays in the page (opacity 0, read by screen readers) and reserves its width; an aria-hidden tabular-nums copy counts over it, right-aligned, so nothing shifts. At the hand-off from the tabular copy to the typed (proportional) text, digits can move 1–2px. With underline on, a light wrapper span stays at rest so the line can stay drawn; textContent is identical and edit mode restores the original markup byte for byte. With underline: false the markup is byte-identical at rest.
